name: Proton Drive Sync
author: xqus
description: Two-way sync between one local folder and one Proton Drive folder, using the official proton-drive CLI. Local changes sync instantly (inotify); remote changes are picked up on a poll interval.

barWidget.description: Watch one local folder and one Proton Drive folder, keep them in sync.

schema.label: Local folder
schema.description: Folder to watch, e.g. ~/ProtonSync. Created if it doesn't exist.

schema.label: Proton Drive folder
schema.description: Remote path under /my-files. Created if it doesn't exist. /devices (Computers) is not supported -- see SPEC.md.

schema.label: Remote poll interval (seconds)
schema.description: How often to check Proton Drive for remote changes. Local changes sync instantly instead of waiting for this.

schema.label: On conflict
schema.description: What to do when a file changed on both sides since the last sync.
